# Apollo team: Release Schedule and project information

- **Source:** [amiga-news.de article](https://www.amiga-news.de/en/news/AN-2025-11-00033-EN.html)
- **Date:** 7 November 2025
- **Author:** Willem (Drijver), signed “dr”
- **Type:** Press release
- **Source link:** [Discord](https://discord.com/channels/726870908568076380/745290452198096957/1435584452800544910)
- **Original language:** English

## Original text

*Apollo Vampire Lair - November 2025 Report*

Hi Vampires, here is the November Update. We are now with 230 Vampires in our Lair and growing! If your are not yet a member, please visit [Apollo Vampire Lair](https://apollo-vampire-lair.com/) to get access to exciting Apollo Software and at the same time support Apollo Software Development!

### News

We are still in negotiation with Microids about the licensing for Robin Hood on Apollo V4 devices / Amiga 68K devices. Based on the discussions earlier this year our expectation was to reach an agreement right after the summer. However due to a change in contact person the progress has been slowed and also have become a little more complicated. As a result of this the current planned release for the full version of [Robin Hood - Legend of Sherwood](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Robin_Hood:_The_Legend_of_Sherwood) on 1st December 2025 will be postponed. The good news however is that the negotiations have been extended to include also the license rights for the [Chicago 1930](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chicago_1930) game which is based on the same engine as Robin Hood. If we can reach an agreement then we will also be seeking for the license rights on [Desperados](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Desperados:_Wanted_Dead_or_Alive) to make the series complete.

### Release Schedule

- Robin Hood - Legend of Sherwood is now postponed to Q1 - 2026
- Chicago 1930 and Desperados are added to schedule with an intended release in Q4 - 2026
- Apollo Invaders is planned for release on 1st December 2025
- ApolloVNC will get a major update which is also planned for 1st December 2025
- ApolloFloppy is still work in progress but planning is still to release this year

### Supported Projects

- Apollo Vampire Lair funds will be used to (hopefully) close the license deals on Robin Hood, Chicago and Desperados. During the negations I cannot give any details, but full disclosure will be given afterwards to give to give you all transparency on the spending of your money
- ApolloCrossDev has been updated and the dependencies on Amiga-GCC (Bebbo) have been restored. Talks have started with Stefan (Bebbo) to invest some structural time in bringing more 68080 optimizations into ApolloCrossDev, including bringing the -m68080 support flag to GCC13.1. More news soon to share.
- Battle for Wesnoth is still on hold awaiting a skilled and motivated Amiga/Apollo developer that wants to take on the project of optimizing the code for Apollo V4. Apollo Vampire Lair has offered a bounty for this Project: Apollo A6000 or 500 euro cash. Please help us find this person!

Greetings, Willem (Drijver) ([dr](https://www.amiga-news.de/en/static/impressum.html#dr))
